info.name: MedLink API · Sprint 2 (registration, email verification, password changes, staff code)
info.description:
Endpoints 1–4 of docs/sprints/sprint-2/plan.md with their edge cases, then folder 6 for endpoints 10–11 (sub-sprint 4) and folder 8 for the staff code, endpoints 8–9 (sub-sprint 3). Practitioners and staff log in with a code: the collection's pre-request script computes it from `{{totpSecret}}` like an authenticator app.

**Before running:** start the dev stack (`scripts/setup-dev.ps1` or `scripts/setup-dev.sh`): API on 8080, Keycloak on 8180, Mailpit on 8025.

**Run it in order** with the Collection Runner (folder 0 first: it stores the CSRF token; folder 6 reuses the account verified in folder 4). Every run uses new emails, so it can be run again. Folder 5 waits 61 seconds; skip it for a quick run.

**Not covered here** (covered by the JUnit tests): a link older than 24 hours (410), Keycloak or SMTP down (503 / still 201), a database failure after the Keycloak user was created, the per-IP limits (429 `TOO_MANY_REQUESTS` with `Retry-After`, GitHub #51: the dev profile raises them to 1000 so this collection can be rerun; `RateLimitFunctionalTest` checks the real values).

Test accounts stay in the dev database and Keycloak; `-Reset` on the setup script wipes them.

exec: // Staff code (MLink-62/63): {{totpCode}} is the current RFC 6238 code of {{totpSecret}} (Base32), as an
// authenticator app shows it; {{wrongTotpCode}} is another 6-digit code. Nothing happens without a secret.
for (let i = 0; i + 8 <= bits.length; i += 8) keyHex += parseInt(bits.substr(i, 8), 2).toString(16).padStart(2, "0");

item.name: 2 · The verification mail (Mailpit)
item.description: Reads the mail the API sent, from Mailpit's API (dev only), and keeps the token of its link.

item.name: Mailpit: one verification mail and one warning for the two duplicate tries

exec: // Mailpit's to: search matches substrings (weak.postman... too): keep the exact recipient
const mine = pm.response.json().messages.filter(x => x.To.some(t => t.Address === to));
const verification = mine.filter(x => x.Subject === "Confirmez votre adresse e-mail MedLink");
const warnings = mine.filter(x => x.Subject === "Tentative d'inscription avec votre adresse e-mail MedLink");
pm.test("one verification mail (the duplicates created nothing)", () => pm.expect(verification.length).to.eql(1));
pm.test("one warning to the owner (two tries, at most one warning per 15 min)", () => pm.expect(warnings.length).to.eql(1));

item.name: Mailpit: the mail is in French and links to the React page

exec: pm.test("greets by first name", () => pm.expect(mail.Text).to.include("Bonjour Amel,"));
pm.test("says the link lasts 24 h", () => pm.expect(mail.Text).to.include("valable 24 heures"));
pm.test("HTML part has a link", () => pm.expect(mail.HTML).to.include('<a href="http://localhost:3000/verifier-email?token='));
pm.test("no Keycloak URL in the mail", () => pm.expect(mail.Text + mail.HTML).to.not.include("8180"));
